falsifiability: falsifiability: Source/Parsek.Tests/WatchEntryAcceptanceWiringGateTests.cs:281; a new consumer whose IsGhostOnBody( call sits after a string literal containing // on the same line -> gate stays green

falsifiability: falsifiability: Source/Parsek/TrajectoryTextSidecarCodec.cs:21 SerializePointValues; write with a de-DE culture while DeserializePoint keeps the invariant parse -> red. Making BOTH sides ambient-culture -> still green on a dot-decimal host

why_weak: The name and doc-comment promise comma-locale safety, but no culture is pinned. The check is symmetric (same ic on write and read), so a codec switched to CurrentCulture round-trips green on the en-US CI host; only Vlad's ro-RO machine would ever red.
proposed_action: Wrap the body in a de-DE CultureInfo scope with a finally restore, the way GuiTreeJsonTests.FloatsStayDotSeparatedUnderDeDE does, or assert the raw POINT node values contain '.' and no ','.

falsifiability: falsifiability: Source/Parsek/TrajectoryTextSidecarCodec.cs:147 SerializeOrbitSegment; write with a de-DE culture while the parse stays invariant -> red. Both sides ambient-culture -> still green on a dot-decimal host
what_it_asserts: An OrbitSegment with fractional elements plus orbitalFrameRotation and angularVelocity survives the trajectory round trip within tolerance.
why_weak: Same gap as the Point twin: the named comma-locale risk is not exercised because the ambient culture is never set to a comma locale, and writer and parser share one CultureInfo.
proposed_action: Set CurrentCulture to de-DE for the body (finally-restored) or assert the raw ORBIT_SEGMENT values are dot-separated.

falsifiability: falsifiability: Source/Parsek/GameActions/KscActionReconciler.cs:83; delete the KscReconcileClass.Transformed skip so ReconcileKscAction reconciles and WARNs -> stays green, because the guard at test line 3254 requires the 'Earnings reconciliation' prefix while the KSC path emits 'KSC reconciliation (funds)'
